name: SelectionTask
caption: Selection task

configuration.description: What the person should choose, and why. Shown on the task card. Supports SmartFields {{..}}, SmartFormulas [[..]] and SmartControls {#..#}. The task's subject is the step's description (fallback: the flow's description).
0 = a single user, 1 = a task group (any member can complete it), 2 = the user who started the flow (assignee is ignored). The editor always writes it. Other values count as user.

Required unless assignType is 2. assignType 0: a Business Central user name (or user security ID); assignType 1: a task group code. Case-insensitive, trimmed. Can be a SmartField resolved when the step runs. The user must exist and be enabled.

The list to choose from: exactly one SmartField placeholder '{{name}}' pointing to a reference, an array or an iterator of records (e.g. '{{<slug>_results}}' of Find Records), or to a value or an array of values. Read in its raw form. Each record or value becomes one row; at most 1,000 rows.
"reference" (records) or "value" (plain values). The editor derives it from the input's type. It decides the type of the 'results' output; at runtime the step goes by what the input actually holds.
Records: the table of the input's records (the tableNo of the 'results' reference output). Values: 0.
Records only: the columns of the list, rows of { caption, value }. Empty: one column with the record's primary key. The editor always writes the array.

SmartText resolved once per row. It must use the input as its prefix, e.g. '{{FindCust_results.name}}' for input '{{FindCust_results}}'; that prefix is pointed at the row's record. Other SmartFields may appear too (resolved against the whole flow context, which is slower). The values are a snapshot taken when the task is created.
Values only: the caption above the values. Empty: the input's name.
true: the person may choose several rows (at least one); false: exactly one.
When the input holds no rows (no task is created then): 0 = fail the step, 1 = continue with count "0" and no 'results'.
Optional. A date (yyyy-mm-dd is safest) or a SmartDate such as [[TODAY+5D]]. A value that does not resolve to a date is ignored silently.

outputs.name: results
outputs.when: once completed, when at least one row was chosen; inputKind "value": type value, no tableNo. {{slug_results}} is the first chosen row, {{slug_results[i]}} the i-th (0-based, in list order) - the same shape as Find Records

outputs.name: count
outputs.when: always once the step finishes - number of chosen rows; "0" when onEmpty = 1 let an empty list through

outputs.name: completedBy
outputs.when: once completed - user name of who completed the task

outputs.name: task
outputs.when: once completed - the task record (table 5564323 mse365 AF-CO Task)

notes: Dark-launched: only available where AutoFlow Tasks (portal feature flag 'tasks') is enabled for the environment. Elsewhere the step is hidden in the editor and publish refuses it.
The rows are built once, when the task is created: column values are a snapshot. Lists longer than 1,000 rows are cut to the first 1,000 (logged), and the task card says the list was cut.

The flow waits in the background like the Approval task: parked, checked every poll interval (AutoFlow Setup 'Task Poll Interval (Min.)', default 5 minutes), and continued immediately when the user the flow runs as completes the task themselves. Each loop pass creates its own task; a retried run reuses the task it created.

Completing a selection task needs a paid AutoFlow licence and an AutoFlow Tasks seat - except assignType 2 (the user who started the flow) completing it while following the run in its progress dialog. Assigning needs no seat; the editor's status line warns when a fixed assignee or every member of a fixed group has no seat.
In a Webhook flow with WaitForResponse, put the step after Respond to Webhook: in the synchronous phase the step cannot park and fails.
If a chosen record was deleted before the task is completed, the person is asked to change the selection.
